purpose: Append raw-hit neighborhoods for the established Sr I states 60057/60705 and 13524 orbit states 70050/70005/70500, explicitly correcting a provisional 70005 no-hit impression after broader authoritative search.

policy.rule: Raw number occurrences are retained for collision statistics and have zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: Existing P1/P2 records may be carried forward for context, but new metadata collisions do not add independent physical evidence.
policy.search_revision: A provisional no-hit is never canonical if a broader or better search later finds a valid exact occurrence; the positive raw record supersedes the provisional search impression while provenance is retained in notes.
